import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for source data
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_42/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0
    # Note: The error message indicates there might be an extra unnamed index column.
    # We use index_col=0 to treat the first column as index if it is unnamed.
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
    # After loading, verify columns and fix if needed
    expected_cols_source0 = ['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp']
    if list(df_source0.columns) != expected_cols_source0:
        # If the first column is not index but a real column, reload without index_col
        df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
        # Drop any unnamed columns if present
        df_source0 = df_source0.loc[:, df_source0.columns.str.contains('^Unnamed') == False]
        # Ensure columns are exactly as expected
        df_source0 = df_source0[expected_cols_source0]

    # Load Source 1
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # We only need 'item_id' and 'movie title' columns from Source 1
    df_source1 = df_source1[['item_id', 'movie title']]

    # Merge Source 0 and Source 1 on 'item_id' to get the movie title for each rating record
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='item_id', how='left')

    # Ensure the target schema and column order:
    # ['user_id': int, 'item_id': int, 'rating': int, 'timestamp': int, 'movie title': str]
    # Convert data types explicitly
    df_merged['user_id'] = df_merged['user_id'].astype(int)
    df_merged['item_id'] = df_merged['item_id'].astype(int)
    df_merged['rating'] = df_merged['rating'].astype(int)
    df_merged['timestamp'] = df_merged['timestamp'].astype(int)
    df_merged['movie title'] = df_merged['movie title'].astype(str)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema
    df_target = df_merged[['user_id', 'item_id', 'rating', 'timestamp', 'movie title']]

    # Write the result to the target CSV file without the index
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
